newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Three Brazilians arrested in Dutch tourist murders.
newsitem.headline: Three Brazilians arrested in Dutch tourist murders.

text.p: Brazilian police arrested three men on Saturday in connection with the killing of two Dutch tourists in the northeastern city of Recife, a police spokesman said.
The two Dutchmen, Aloysius Theodorus Overtoon, 35, and Wilhelmus Adrianes Joannes Van Kampen, 28, were shot dead early on Friday in one of the most dangerous shantytown areas of Recife.
The police spokesman said three men suspected of taking part in the attack had been arrested, but two other suspects were still on the run.
He said the Dutch tourists, who arrived in Brazil on Dec. 12, had gone to the shantytown to buy drugs and while they were waiting they were attacked by five men for their money.
